name: zan-workflows
description: Company project and stateless functional TAPD workflows, plus MR review, debug token, identity, and memory skills for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Company project and functional TAPD workflows.
interface.longDescription: Bundles project context; six function-like TAPD skills for preparing, implementing, drafting Wiki content, submitting, going live, and sequentially handling one or more Bugs on one fixed branch; plus GitLab MR review, debug tokens, team identity, and project memory workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use the appropriate Zan workflow skill for this task.
Handle one or more TAPD Bugs sequentially on the supplied fixed branch without creating workflow record files.
Resolve and scope each TAPD work item before changing code.
Repair, draft a TAPD Wiki, submit for test, or merge to master with the matching functional skill.
